summary: Lost Type's microsite for Dave Bailey's optical-size serif, staged as 'The Daily Prospectus' newspaper in peach, red-orange and olive on grey. It opens on an editable dictionary-entry front page and a full-control tester whose optical size switches automatically with the font size. Editable classified ads are each set in a different optical size, and a sticky 'intended size' switcher resizes the samples. A long first-person making-of essay with archival sources follows, then colour-coded package cards and credits that close with a waterfall of the four optical sizes.

instances.look: A peach newspaper page on flat grey, strewn with orange, olive and peach paper-cut blobs: masthead 'The Daily Prospectus' with a Lost Type roundel, 'A Lost Type Co-op Publication / Drawing new shapes for you to read since 2011' and today's date, then a dictionary entry 'pro·spec·tus: noun' with two numbered senses (the second: 'A new and bold contemporary serif typeface, with optical sizes, designed by Dave Bailey…') and an 'origin' paragraph
instances.ux: The masthead (and entry) are editable Draft.js lines with a blinking caret; the blobs drift in and settle as the page loads; no buttons or nav
instances.learn: Define the font's name like a dictionary entry: roman, italic, bold, small and large sizes all appear naturally, and the second sense is the pitch

reconstruction.content: Dictionary entry for 'prospectus' with real etymology (Latin prōspicere)
reconstruction.assets: Paper-cut blob SVGs (illustrations by Marisol Ortega); Lost Type roundel logo
